hypothesis: The first completed fifteen-minute auction after the Europe and US inventory transfers can distinguish initiative from absorption when dominant CL effort is judged against only its four immediately preceding completed auction bars and matched-month MCL confirms result.

clock.reference: exactly four contiguous completed fifteen-minute CL/MCL bars ending at anchor-45m, anchor-30m, anchor-15m, and anchor
clock.auction: exactly fifteen contiguous one-minute CL/MCL bars ending anchor+15m
clock.projected_entry: next matched-contract MCL one-minute open at auction close plus one minute

effort.primary: auction CL volume greater than or equal to the exact median of the preceding four CL fifteen-minute volumes and positive auction MCL volume
effort.count_control: same causal classifications without the CL volume condition; count-only and never selectable

mutually_exclusive_branches.absorption_high: CL and MCL jointly probe above their own preceding-hour high and both close back at or below it; propose down
mutually_exclusive_branches.absorption_low: CL and MCL jointly probe below their own preceding-hour low and both close back at or above it; propose up
mutually_exclusive_branches.initiative_up: CL and MCL bodies are both positive and both close locations are at least 0.75; propose up
mutually_exclusive_branches.initiative_down: CL and MCL bodies are both negative and both close locations are at most 0.25; propose down

decision_law.eligible: Only if the primary effort-gated census passes every eligibility requirement independently in discovery and validation-count periods may one exact lifecycle be preregistered before outcomes.
decision_law.ineligible: Reject the opening-drive family at this definition; do not rescue cadence by changing anchor, bar length, close-location quartile, volume statistic, branch precedence, or cohort floors after observing counts.
decision_law.validation_outcomes: Remain sealed even when validation counts are inspected.
